title: BhutanECCDHermesObservation
description: Structured observation Hermes posts to Pulse API (POST /observations/from-hermes).

childId.description: Stable Pulse child id when known (e.g. c1). Optional if childName resolves uniquely.

domain.description: MoESD ELDS domain or close mapping

transcription.description: Raw or cleaned voice transcription when source=voice

parentSafeTitle.description: Warm title for the guardian; must not name other children

parentSafeDesc.description: Parent-facing description; no other children's names

rawRef.description: Optional pointer to Telegram file_id, object storage key, or CCTV clip id

mediaUrls.description: Cloudinary (or other CDN) URLs after upload. For multi-child Telegram captions, POST /media/photo-from-hermes once with the same URLs fan-out per @tag.

examples.trigger: Group noise overload & resource sharing boundary
examples.strategy: Calm hand gesture + Soft Dzongkha verbal soothing
examples.milestone: Shares play materials with peer after soft prompt (Emerging -> Proficient)
examples.transcription: Today during morning group activities... Tashi Dorji...
examples.parentSafeDesc: Tashi offered blocks to a friend after a calm prompt — great Social & Emotional progress.
